title: PM-BG-AES Supplementary Research Artifacts
description: Selected PM-BG-AES notebook implementation ported to Python, sanitized public notebooks, documentation, synthetic inputs DEMO-001 through DEMO-011, and newly measured demonstration results. The conservative initial release excludes supplied F1-F9 original/encrypted/decrypted payloads, the entire historical results/analysis result/ folder, raw notebooks, and DOCX manuscripts/reports. Historical artifact-consistency findings are documented, but original-run attribution, timing reproduction, UCEF analysis, and original figure generation remain unconfirmed. This is a research artifact, not production cryptography.
notes: Team approval reported/confirmed by repository maintainer Dwi Wijonarko on 2026-10-08. Source: maintainer instruction for the current task; no individual signatures, independent third-party permission, or historical experiment provenance is asserted. MIT covers repository-owned code, documentation, and synthetic demo data, not excluded third-party research materials. The nine metadata names and their existing order are confirmed; specific contributor roles are not assigned. Local candidate prepared; publication performed by maintainer after candidate validation.
